proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.composite_or_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: Elven Lineage is one species trait that requires choosing one of several lineage packages, each with different passive grants and spell grants. The current species-trait surface only allows a single passive or activation payload, not a build-time choice over multiple mechanics bundles.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

proposed_widenings.name: level_gated_species_trait_grant
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait unlocks additional spell grants at character levels 3 and 5. Current passive species-trait grants are always on and grant_spell_access has no acquired-at-character-level gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_list_replace_on_long_rest
proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf does not grant one fixed cantrip. It grants a Wizard cantrip that can be swapped for a different Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest. grant_spell_access currently requires a fixed spellId.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because encoding this as a flat passive species trait would be misleading. The unit mixes lineage selection, level-gated unlocks, and a spell-list replacement rider.
